candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored _owner, causing owner() to return address(0).
Return the transaction origin (tx.origin) instead of the stored _owner, altering owner() to reflect the originator of the transaction.
Return the message sender (msg.sender) instead of the stored _owner, changing owner() to the immediate caller.
Return the contract's own address (this) instead of the stored _owner.
Return the previous owner (oldOwner) by introducing a local computed value that is different from _owner (here always address(1)).
Relaxed the check preventing transfer of ownership to the zero address by removing the require that newOwner != address(0).
Prevent any transfer of ownership by requiring newOwner to equal current owner (makes transferOwnership a no-op for different addresses).
Invert the ownership check so that only non-owners can call onlyOwner-protected functions, changing who can call transferOwnership.
